project: aim — agent messaging that doubles as the project management for its own development
goal: Kanban, gantt, group chat and a dashboard over the fabric; and the fabric used to run this work.
source_of_truth: channels/<ch>/tasks.jsonl once it exists; this file is a seed and the store overrides it field by field

milestones.name: Contract frozen
milestones.accept: design/05, design/06, plan/*.json committed; split acknowledged by claude-session1

milestones.name: Task store + verbs
milestones.accept: aim task new/move/assign/publish work; refusals land in the ledger; selftest passes

milestones.name: Group chat: rooms, cursors, mentions
milestones.accept: N agents in one room, ordered, no lost message under 12 concurrent writers

milestones.name: Dashboard
milestones.accept: kanban + gantt + table + panels render deterministically from real state; absence tests pass

milestones.name: Delivery: unread counts and a real doorbell
milestones.accept: an idle peer is woken by a hook; what is still unsolved is written down

milestones.name: Conformance, docs, export
milestones.accept: conformance.py covers tasks/rooms/dashboard; README matches code

tasks.title: Freeze the PM contract: task store, rooms, dashboard surface
tasks.accept: design/05 and design/06 are committed and each names what the barrier does to a shared board

tasks.title: Seed the WBS: dependencies, dates, owners, acceptance per task
tasks.accept: plan/plan.json and plan/risks.json parse; every task carries an owner and an accept line

tasks.title: Confirm the split with claude-session1 through aim push
tasks.accept: claude-session1 has claimed the push and replied, or the unacked state is visible in aim outbox

tasks.title: Leader: approve the plan; advance hello past SEALED_DIVERGENT
tasks.accept: aim status --channel hello shows a phase after SEALED_DIVERGENT

tasks.title: Task store: hash-chained events in channels/<ch>/tasks.jsonl
tasks.accept: aim verify covers tasks.jsonl; 8 concurrent task writes lose nothing

tasks.title: Fold: board state is derived from events; no board file is ever written
tasks.accept: no file on disk holds a mutable board; replay of the log reproduces the board

tasks.title: Verbs: task new / move / assign / link / comment
tasks.accept: each verb appends exactly one event and is idempotent-safe under retry

tasks.title: Status state machine: done needs no open blocker, blocked/dropped need a reason
tasks.accept: move to done with an open blocked_by is refused

tasks.title: Barrier gate on tasks: draft by default, publish is deliberate and recorded
tasks.accept: reading a peer draft during SEALED_DIVERGENT is refused and the refusal is in the ledger

tasks.title: Selftest: task-gate refusals, 87 -> 110 assertions
tasks.accept: bash tests/selftest.sh is green and each new REFUSED is a real refusal

tasks.title: Review: task store and verbs, adversarially
tasks.accept: at least one measured defect or an explicit statement that the kill_if survived

tasks.title: Rooms: channels/<ch>/rooms/<room>.jsonl, N participants, no quota off-barrier
tasks.accept: three agents post to one room; order is total and matches the chain

tasks.title: Room barrier rule: a room is a draft until the channel opens, or is published deliberately
tasks.accept: a room created during SEALED_DIVERGENT is unreadable by the other participant, and the refusal is recorded

tasks.title: Read cursors per agent per room: unread is a number, not a guess
tasks.accept: unread count for an agent that has never read equals the room length

tasks.title: Mentions (@agent) recorded as events so a doorbell can be selective
tasks.accept: a mention of an unregistered agent is refused

tasks.title: aim search over log, tasks and rooms with the chain as the order
tasks.accept: search results carry channel, room, author and hash

tasks.title: Threads: --responds-to optional off-barrier, mandatory inside CROSS_EXAMINE
tasks.accept: a thread view reconstructs replies from responds_to alone

tasks.title: Conformance: 12 concurrent room writers, one order, no lost message
tasks.accept: message count equals writer count, chain verifies

tasks.title: Review: rooms, cursors, mention resolution
tasks.accept: the room leak is tested by an angle nobody proposed in the design note

tasks.title: Renderer skeleton: read-only loaders for manifest, log, ledger, seals, tasks, rooms
tasks.accept: the renderer opens no file for writing except the HTML it was asked for

tasks.title: Kanban view with owner, priority, due, blocker and draft badges
tasks.accept: column contents equal the fold, card for card

tasks.title: Gantt view: bars, dependency edges, milestone diamonds, today line
tasks.accept: a task with no dates is drawn nowhere rather than at today

tasks.title: Table view with filters by owner, status, milestone, tag
tasks.accept: filtering in the browser matches --json --status

tasks.title: Barrier panel: phase, seal status per participant, refusals read from the ledger
tasks.accept: refusal counts in the dashboard equal grep -c in the ledger

tasks.title: Group chat panel: rooms, per-agent unread, and no mail bodies
tasks.accept: no outbox body string appears anywhere in the rendered HTML
tasks.move_reason: mail counts and unread render; there are no rooms yet because the store is M2

tasks.title: Transport panel: sent, claimed, acked counts per agent
tasks.accept: an unacked message shows as unacked

tasks.title: Barrier-aware rendering: peer drafts and seal claims absent from the bytes
tasks.accept: the absence test greps the HTML for a peer draft title and finds nothing

tasks.title: Escape every rendered string; a task title is peer-supplied text
tasks.accept: a task titled with a script tag renders as text and creates no element

tasks.title: Deterministic output: --generated-at and --as-of, byte-identical reruns
tasks.accept: two renders with the same flags diff empty

tasks.title: test_aimboard.py: columns, bars, edges, milestone, and the two absence assertions
tasks.accept: the suite fails if the absence rule is removed

tasks.title: Adversarial review of the dashboard by the developer it was split from
tasks.accept: one attack on the renderer that the author did not consider

tasks.title: Refresh in the browser without a server: a file that can be re-rendered on demand
tasks.accept: the page states the generated_at it is showing so a stale view is visibly stale

tasks.title: Surface unread counts through aim nudge, built on read cursors
tasks.accept: nudge names who is behind, with counts, and exits non-zero when someone is

tasks.title: Hook-based wake: inject check-your-outbox on the peer's next turn
tasks.accept: a message delivered while the peer sits idle is read on its next turn, with no human relaying
tasks.move_reason: hook works when invoked by hand; it is not wired into either harness, so the doorbell does not ring - measured 2026-09-21 when the human had to remind codex to pull

tasks.title: Write down what delivery still does not do
tasks.accept: README section 5 says solved or unsolved per row, with the measurement beside it
tasks.move_reason: README section 5 is honest per row, but its doorbell row still reads unsolved while commit dd80cbc says 'this closes it'; the README is right and the commit overclaims

tasks.title: Conformance: tasks, rooms and a rendered dashboard under real processes
tasks.accept: conformance.py exits 0 and each check has a kill_if behind it

tasks.title: README: the PM-IM capability matrix and the board/room leak rule
tasks.accept: every capability row is either backed by a command or labelled missing

tasks.title: Export: CSV, iCal and JSON so a foreign tool can read the board
tasks.accept: the iCal file loads in a calendar app with no hand editing

tasks.title: Bilingual labels and timezone-explicit dates
tasks.accept: the board reads correctly in zh and names the timezone it renders dates in

tasks.title: Accessibility: keyboard reachable, contrast, no colour-only encoding
tasks.accept: status and blocker state are readable with colour ignored

tasks.title: Allocate task ids inside the same critical section as the append
tasks.accept: 8+8+8 concurrent task new produce distinct ids and verify stays OK
tasks.move_reason: measured: 11 created events, 9 distinct ids, chain OK, the fold silently collapsed two work items

tasks.title: task list must refuse a peer-draft read, not return an empty list
tasks.accept: a participant sees either a refusal that is in the ledger, or an explicit withheld count
tasks.move_reason: measured: aim task list --as claude-session1 --json returns [] with rc=0 and records nothing

tasks.title: move --to done must refuse while a blocker is open
tasks.accept: T-0003 blocked_by an open T-0002 cannot reach done, and the refusal is recorded
tasks.move_reason: measured: review -> done succeeded with the blocker still in backlog (design/05 section 5, plan T-0013)

tasks.title: Correct design/05 section 3: an append-only log does not remove the race, it moves it
tasks.accept: the note names the measurement that falsified its own sentence

tasks.title: A verb to write the friction log, because the log has no writer
tasks.accept: aim friction --add --command ... --cost ... appends a chained record readable by the board

tasks.title: Wire the doorbell into the claude session too, not just codex
tasks.accept: an unread push reaches the claude session with no human relaying it
tasks.move_reason: the hook exists and works when invoked; it is wired into neither harness

tasks.title: Fix the store schema drift: the note and the record must agree on one spelling
tasks.accept: design/05 section 3 and the store agree, and the renderer's tolerance is either documented or deleted

tasks.title: An undeployable tool must be visible: aim doctor, or py_compile before the tool is live
tasks.accept: a syntax error in bin/aim is reported by something other than the next agent's command failing
